about: Frozen verdicts of main's floor.rs (pre-2026-10-03 is_bun_token family) — the Bun name profile must reproduce every bit. Bits: token, decorated, belowFloor, sweepAcceptable, borrowable, echo, halfMint, wordless. stems: the borrowable minified names of 2.1.119; the third column is borrowed_minified_stem(name, stems). Stems trimmed to those that occur (case-insensitively) inside some row name; the rest cannot change any verdict.
